understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to be won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the currently selected piece one grid cell per directional action, with positions represented in pixel coordinates using a 3-pixel cell size. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries could block movement. CLICK selected a different selectable piece using its pixel-coordinate position, allowing the pieces to be maneuvered independently.
